newsitem.title: CANADA: Loewen to review Service offer.
newsitem.headline: Loewen to review Service offer.

text.p: Canadian-based funeral home operator Loewen Group Inc said on Tuesday that its board of directors will review a US$43 a share takeover bid from rival Service Corp International.
"The Loewen board of directors will review the proposal received today...and will respond in due course," the company said in a statement.
Shares in Vancouver-based Loewen were up sharply on Canadian and U.S. stock exchanges, but off earlier highs reached shortly after the bid was announced this morning.
Loewen's stock was up 6.55 at 53.05 on the Toronto Stock Exchange at midday, after hitting a 52-week high of 57.
On Nasdaq, the stock gained 5 to 38-3/4, but was down from a peak of 42-1/2 reached earlier in the session.

Stock traders said the market is wary about whether Service Corp's hostile bid will succeed. "People may decide to take the money now instead of waiting for a few more dollars three months down the road," a Canadian trader said.
